raw_sections.summary:
SUMMARY
Adaptable IT professional with 7.2 years of experience in the Workday and PeopleSoft ecosystem, including 4.4 years of hands-on expertise in designing, developing, and implementing robust integration solutions using Workday Integrations and Workday Extend. Skilled in integrating HR and Financial modules to streamline business processes, improve data accuracy, and enhance overall system efficiency.
raw_sections.skills:
SKILLS
Programming Languages: JSON, XSLT 2.0, Fundamentals of XSLT 3.0, WQL, SOAP & REST based APIs, Java, PeopleCode and SQL
Tools: Workday Studio, Workday Extend, Workday Orchestration, Postman, SOAP UI, WinSCP, IPSwitch, Oxygen XML Editor, and PGP Encryption/Decryption
Databases: MS SQL Server and Oracle Database  Adept with Cisco Tidal Workload Automation tool (6.5.5).  Well versed with MS Office tools like MS Excel, MS Word, and MS PowerPoint.
CERTIFICATION
Workday HCM Essential Concepts Consulting Core  Workday Pro Integrations Certification  Workday Extend Consulting Core
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Avalara Technologies, Pune (Remote) Applications Engineer, November 2024 – Present
Developed and retrofitted integrations with third-party vendors such as Concur, Everbridge, ServiceNow, Okta, iCIMS, and Espresa to enable seamless data exchange and process automation.  Built and deployed a Workday Extend application to measure quality of hire through post-hire surveys, improving recruitment analytics and decision-making.
Designed a Workday Extend application to track worker promotion reviews and nominations within the talent performance cycle, enhancing visibility for HR and leadership teams.
Developed and optimized integrations with global benefit providers to streamline Open Eligibility periods and ensure accurate employee benefits administration.
Engineered API-based integrations to implement a centralized Vendor Management System with Staffing Nation, reducing vendor management overhead and improving data consistency.
Designing a Payroll Effective Change Interface (PECI) integration for a Brazilian third-party payroll vendor, ensuring compliance with local requirements.
Deloitte Consulting India (Offices of the US), Mumbai Workday Integration Consultant, May 2021 – October 2024
Spearheaded design, development, and hyper care for a Phase X Absence & Time Tracking implementation project, which was spread across two time zones for a fortune 500 pharmaceutical company. Implemented studio integrations involving RaaS calls and complex advanced reports.
 Design & developed PECI integrations for an Acquisition based project aimed at eliminating a middleware application, SnapLogic.
 Led the way to design & develop ~17 EIB integrations for a Russia based payroll provider which
were then configured on various business processes.
Exposure to BIRT & composite reports while assisting fellow peers for financial reporting.  Maintaining & enhancing key financial core-connector & studio integrations with Workday Web Services around journal loads, budget loads, etc.
Experience in designing & developing following financial integrations- o Boomerang integrations to update customer & supplier invoices. o Implemented journal load & Ad Hoc Bank transaction integrations with a third-party system o Built an interface between Adaptive Planning & Workday to load budgets.
Single-handedly built dashboard capturing integration runs, health checks, and schedule statuses to showcase system insights to key decision makers.
Leading India based offshore team & assisting wherever required.  Optimized critical integrations & business functions enhancing Workday experience for the client.  Designing an Extend application for existing customer which will influence subscription to the Extend services. In addition to project deliverables, involved in firm activities to add value for the organization.

L&T Infotech, Navi Mumbai PeopleSoft Technical Consultant, July 2018 – May 2021
Experience in third-party integrations- Concur, Guidewire, Vertex, Bank of America, and the US Bank.
Propose technical solutions and possible workaround for the defects reported to the continuation of the business processes.
Key Responsibilities: handling batch jobs scheduled through Cisco's scheduler- Tidal; performing enhancements as per business requirements; and providing estimates for a change request.
Control over Application Designer, MS SQL Server 2012, SQR & PeopleCode. Closely worked on the component interface, application engine, ExcelToCI, PS Query, pivot grid, page field configurator, data migration workbench, business process weaver, data archive manager, application packages and integration broker.
Apart from an ongoing project, actively worked in the Centre of Excellence team for tools development. The task included creation and deployment of tools which facilitate support & maintenance projects and accelerate upgrade projects.

EDUCATION
University Of Mumbai Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics & Telecommunication
